notes: The programmes own page is the Parcoursup fiche. The page states that foreign non-EU applicants residing in a country with a Campus France Etudes en France procedure must not register on Parcoursup but should apply via Campus France; applicationChannel is therefore omitted as instructed. Tuition fee figures on the fiche (6370-12370 EUR/year, 3490-5590 EUR/year for boursiers) are given without distinguishing non-EU applicants and appear tied to the Parcoursup/CVEC context; no non-EU-specific fee is stated, so tuition is left out. The page mentions 'Frais de dossiers IE 70,00 € (candidats non boursiers) 0,00 € (candidats boursiers)' as an application file fee, not tuition. Documents: the selection criteria mention 'Lettre de motivation et entretien' (motivation letter and interview) but this is a criterion for evaluating applications, not a required document list, so documents is left empty.
